edits.new:
This bidang usaha is allocated to Koperasi and UMKM under Perpres 49/2021's Lampiran II (p.4, entry 15 "Industri kerajinan ukiran dari kayu bukan mebeller"), so a PT PMA cannot register it. The steps below are the Koperasi/UMKM registration route, not a PMA one.
1. **NIB via OSS** — register on oss.go.id as a Koperasi/UMKM entity, select this code, issued automatically (1–3 days)
2. **Submit industrial data report every 6 months (Kemenperin)** — post-license obligation
3. **Menjamin keamanan dan keselamatan alat, proses, hasil produksi, penyimpanan, serta pengangkutan, ses...** — post-license obligation
4. **Memiliki dokumen legalitas bahan baku, berupa: a) Surat Keterangan Sahnya Hasil Hutan (SKSHH); b) Su...** — post-license obligation

**Authority by scale:**
Small: **Bupati/Walikota** (Otomatis) · Medium: **Bupati/Walikota Gubernur** (Otomatis) · Large: **Gubernur Menteri/ Kepala Badan** (Otomatis)
